limits: Reads the selection; with none there is no record.
bio.jane/contract.noScientificClaim: Hands on the selected region unchanged.
bio.jane/contract.question: What is the region selected on the canvas, as a record?

description: The region selected on the canvas, as its own record. This is what makes a highlighted stretch a pipeline INPUT: wire its record into any node's subject and that step runs on the selection rather than on the whole molecule.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

pad.description: extend the selection by this many bases on each side, clamped to the molecule (or wrapped, on a circular one). In bp.

reverse_complement.description: emit the bottom strand of the selection (what a feature on the minus strand actually reads).

name: get_selection

record.description: the selected region as a linear record (subject for downstream nodes)
